The contractor shall be responsible for providing RealSAM Dialog licenses and services required to operate the system in production, while meeting all IT information-system security requirements as required by the Library of Congress. C.2 BACKGROUND NLS administers a free program that loans audio and braille books and magazines, music scores in braille and large print, and specially designed audio-playback and refreshable-braille-display equipment to residents of the United States who are unable to read or use standard print materials due to visual or physical impairment. NLS administers the program nationally, while direct service to eligible individuals and institutions is the responsibility of cooperating network libraries in the various states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, Guam, and the U. S. Virgin Islands. This service is also extended to eligible American citizens residing abroad. Volituste kestus ning ulatus lepitakse kokku igal korral eraldi, ilma ebamõistliku viivituseta. Seejuures ei piira ega vabasta volikirja puudumine Täitjat ühestki talle seaduse või lepingu alusel rakenduvast kohustusest. Kolmanda isiku sellise nõude esitamisel hüvitab Täitja Tellijale nõudega seotud kahju ja mõistlikud kulud ning tagab Tellijale Teenuse raames loodud teoste edasikasutamise võimaluse, sealhulgas omal kulul vajaduse korral asendab või muudab teose või hangib Tellijale vajaliku kasutusõiguse.
